item.title: A Light Filled Eco Home by The Dunes in Findhorn
item.description: Located in The Park Eco Village in Findhorn, 562 West Whins is a Makar built one bedroom eco home with vaulted ceilings, floor to ceiling windows and private garden, just minutes from dunes and Moray Firth beaches.The post A Light Filled Eco Home by The Dunes in Findhorn appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Landlord Sought for Crown Inn in Stornoway
item.description: Star Pubs is seeking a new landlord for The Crown Inn in Stornoway, with the 16 bedroom hotel and pub marketed as a potential £1.1 million turnover opportunity in the heart of the Outer Hebrides. The post New Landlord Sought for Crown Inn in Stornoway appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: ALBA Candidates Urge UK Minister to Back Haventus Ardersier Project
item.description: ALBA Party candidates in the Highlands and Islands have written to the UK Energy Minister urging full backing for the Haventus Ardersier project, which is expected to support around 1,500 jobs.The post ALBA Candidates Urge UK Minister to Back Haventus Ardersier Project appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £1 Million Social Programme Announced Ahead of 2027 Tour De France Grand Départ
item.description: A £1 million social impact programme has been launched to ensure Scotland secures a lasting legacy from hosting the 2027 Tour de France Grand Départ, with projects aimed at boosting participation and wellbeing nationwide.The post £1 Million Social Programme Announced Ahead of 2027 Tour De France Grand Départ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Passes Budget With NHS and Cost Of Living at its Core
item.description: MSPs have passed the Scottish Budget, with the SNP saying record NHS funding and expanded cost of living support show it is focused on Scotland’s priorities ahead of May’s election.The post SNP Passes Budget With NHS and Cost Of Living at its Core appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Archie Foundation Calls on Highlands to Step up for Marathon March 2026
item.description: The Archie Foundation is inviting people across the Highlands to take part in Marathon March 2026, raising vital funds for babies and children in local hospitals while building a powerful show of community support.The post Archie Foundation Calls on Highlands to Step up for Marathon March 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Veterans to Produce Signs for Scotland’s National Forests
item.description: Veterans at Scotland’s Bravest Manufacturing Company will produce signage for Scotland’s national forests under a new Forestry and Land Scotland contract, supporting secure employment while keeping forest sites safe and clearly marked.The post Veterans to Produce Signs for Scotland’s National Forests appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Appeal After Cyclist Seriously Injured in Inverness Crash
item.description: A 30 year old cyclist has been seriously injured after a crash with a car in Inverness on 25 February 2026, with police appealing for witnesses and dashcam footage to help establish what happened.The post Police Appeal After Cyclist Seriously Injured in Inverness Crash appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Accuses Anas Sarwar of Relying on Family Funds to Back Political Career
item.description: The SNP has accused Scottish Labour leader Anas Sarwar of relying on nearly £296,000 in family linked funding since 2010, reigniting debate over political donations and leadership credibility ahead of party conference.The post SNP Accuses Anas Sarwar of Relying on Family Funds to Back Political Career appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Caley Thistle to Face Raith Rovers in KDM Evolution Trophy Final
item.description: Inverness Caledonian Thistle will face Raith Rovers in the 2025 26 KDM Evolution Trophy final at Firhill on 5 April, with £150,000 and national silverware on the line in a live BBC ALBA broadcast.The post Caley Thistle to Face Raith Rovers in KDM Evolution Trophy Final appeared first on The Highland Times.
